name: addpipe16_kogge_stone
rationale: The frontier shows the fully parallel-prefix (16,) adder gives the best proxy_reward_v0 (dominated by the 10x WNS weight), but its area (365.75) suggests the generic '+' operator was mapped to a fairly generic prefix tree by the synthesizer, not necessarily the minimum-depth structure. Explicitly coding a true 4-stage Kogge-Stone (log2(16)=4) generate/propagate prefix adder gives the theoretical minimum logic depth for 16-bit carry computation, which should match or beat the best observed WNS while potentially reducing area versus whatever structure the tool inferred for the unconstrained '+' case, improving on both minimum-area and minimum-area/best-WNS Pareto points.
